note: quince#65, the sixth blind spot: an APPROVED PR whose CI then completes. Nothing happens TO the PR — `updatedAt` is frozen at the approval, measured across fourteen samples on quince#66 while `image` and `e2e` both completed — so the unenumerated `updated` backstop structurally cannot see it, and `checks` never fired because SUCCESS is deliberately not a checks event. quince#63 sat landable and unmerged for sixteen minutes behind a live, quiet watch. The only field that moves is `mergeStateStatus`, and the value it moves to is the one that means nothing is blocking the merge. Note the whole point of the pair: identical `updatedAt`, and no `updated` event in the expectation.
